notes.note: Reviewed Browser and Device boundary claims against the annotation capture and pick changes in the route, registry, picker and pane API. Annotation waits for any earlier screenshot, captures with a checked viewport origin, and rejects selection if that origin changes; regular screenshot sharing and agent authority remain unchanged. The Browser guide names the scroll refusal and redaction limit. Historical designs retain their status; focused route, picker and UI tests passed, while desktop and live remote clients were not verified.
